module_title: Countries and Currencies - The Eurozone, Oil Diplomacis, and ASEAN Pillars
introduction: This intermediate tier transitions to key global trade blocs. It encompasses major European nations that operate under a unified currency, Middle Eastern oil-exporting powers, and rapidly growing South-East Asian tourism and technology hubs.

core_concepts.title: The European Union & The Eurozone
core_concepts.description:
Many major continental European economic powers share a single currency unit:
- France: Capital - Paris, Currency - Euro (€)
- Germany: Capital - Berlin, Currency - Euro (€)
- Italy: Capital - Rome, Currency - Euro (€)
- Spain: Capital - Madrid, Currency - Euro (€)

core_concepts.title: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Nations
core_concepts.description:
Highly high-yielding targets owing to India's intense energy trade and remittance links:
- Saudi Arabia: Capital - Riyadh, Currency - Saudi Riyal
- United Arab Emirates (UAE): Capital - Abu Dhabi, Currency - UAE Dirham
- Kuwait: Capital - Kuwait City, Currency - Kuwaiti Dinar (The most expensive currency globally)

core_concepts.title: ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) Blocks
core_concepts.description:
Crucial Asian trade neighbors:
- Indonesia: Capital - Nusantara (New) / Jakarta, Currency - Rupiah
- Thailand: Capital - Bangkok, Currency - Thai Baht
- Myanmar: Capital - Naypyidaw, Currency - Kyat

important_entities.name: Kuwait
important_entities.significance: The Kuwaiti Dinar (KWD) consistently ranks as the world's highest-valued currency unit relative to the US dollar.

important_entities.name: Australia
important_entities.significance: A standard geographical trap where students guess Sydney or Melbourne as the capital, while the official capital is Canberra.

important_entities.name: South Korea
important_entities.significance: An East Asian tech powerhouse whose currency 'Won' is highly favored in recent selection board questions.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Outdated textbooks list 'Jakarta' as the definitive capital. Due to heavy environmental sinking issues, Indonesia is relocating its administrative capital to 'Nusantara', a brand-new planned city on the island of Borneo. Stay updated.

Do not mix up the three primary currency names used across the Gulf blocks:
- UAE = Dirham
- Saudi Arabia / Qatar = Riyal
- Kuwait / Iraq / Jordan = Dinar
Keep these thoroughly sorted on a regional chart.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Phonetically connect Bangkok directly to the currency unit 'Baht'.
Associate the distinct syllable 'Nay' directly with the capital name Naypyidaw.

exam_strategy_tips: TCS-patterned papers intentionally trick candidates by mixing up 'Dinar' and 'Riyal' tags across neighboring Middle Eastern choices. Focus on segregating them perfectly.
